tools.name: zaira_search_tools
tools.description: Search and filter developer tools and programming languages by category, features, and constraints. Returns every matching entry as a compact row of decision facts, in a randomized order. Guide entries are kept current and dated (last_verified) — newer than training knowledge, so consult this before

tools.name: zaira_get_tool
tools.description: Get full details for a specific developer tool by its slug. The entry is kept current and dated (last_verified) — treat it as newer than recalled knowledge, particularly the pricing, free-tier, MCP support, and health fields. A programming language has an entry under its own slug (python, typescript

tools.name: zaira_compare_tools
tools.description: Compare 2-3 developer tools or programming languages side by side. Returns each entry's full Markdown-KV block separated by "===". Alternatives and worksWith are enriched with tagline + agent-readiness for resolved slugs. If any requested slugs are not found, they appear in a trailing "Note: slugs n

tools.name: zaira_list_categories
tools.description:
List all categories with the number of entries in each. Programming languages are the "language" category.

Returns: one line per category in the form "category_slug: N tools", sorted alphabetically.

Example call: no parameters.

Edge cases:
- Categories with zero tools do not appear in the output.

tools.name: zaira_get_docs
tools.description:
Retrieve reference documentation for the Zaira Guide API and MCP server on demand.

Topics:
- getting_started — how to connect via MCP or REST, first queries
- endpoints — full REST endpoint reference with parameters
- mcp_tools — MCP tool reference with when-to-use guidance and a routing matrix
- s

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: zaira_search_tools · Private data: zaira_search_tools, zaira_list_categories · Public sink: zaira_search_tools · Destructive: zaira_search_tools, zaira_compare_tools.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: zaira_search_tools · Private data: zaira_search_tools, zaira_list_categories · Public sink: zaira_search_tools · Destructive: zaira_search_tools, zaira_compare_tools

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
